newsHighlights.title: First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit
newsHighlights.summary: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, where modern technology meets an ancient Chinese water town.
newsHighlights.translation: 2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将于11月2日至5日在浙江乌镇举行，现代科技将与中国千年古镇相遇。

newsHighlights.title: Desire for better sleep creating opportunities around world
newsHighlights.summary: People's growing desire for better sleep is creating new business and research opportunities around the world.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球范围内对更好睡眠的渴望正在创造新的商业与研究机遇。

newsHighlights.title: South African vlogger discovers a hidden gem
newsHighlights.summary: A South African vlogger shares his journey of discovering a hidden gem in China through curiosity and cultural exchange.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位南非视频博主凭借好奇心与文化交流，在中国发现了一处“隐藏的宝藏”。

newsHighlights.title: Chinese opera hits big in small theaters
newsHighlights.summary: Chinese opera is winning new audiences as small theaters bring the traditional art form closer to young people.
newsHighlights.translation: 随着小剧场让传统艺术走近年轻人，中国戏曲正在赢得新的观众。

newsHighlights.title: World Bank director sees China's buzzwords
newsHighlights.summary: A World Bank director shares his views on China's buzzwords and what they reveal about the country's development path.
newsHighlights.translation: 世界银行一位负责人解读中国“热词”，并阐述这些词汇背后的发展路径。

quote.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quote.author: Nelson Mandela
quote.translation: 教育是你能用来改变世界的最强大的武器。
quote.explanation: 曼德拉强调教育的变革力量：个人的成长与学习不仅塑造自己，也能推动社会进步。这与今日新闻中科技峰会、文化交流和传统艺术焕新都离不开“学习”这一主题相呼应。

pattern.pattern: What will happen when ... meets ...?（当……遇上……会发生什么？）
pattern.example: What will happen when modern technology meets China's ancient town?
pattern.translation: 当现代科技遇上中国的古镇，会发生什么？
pattern.usage: 用于描述两种事物（尤其是传统与现代、不同文化）碰撞时的未知效果，语气富有期待感。写作和演讲中可用于引入话题。例如：What will happen when AI meets the classroom?

grammar.title: 情态动词 might / could 表示委婉推测
grammar.explanation: might 和 could 除了表示过去的能力，还可表示对未来的推测，语气比 will 更委婉、留有余地，常用于讨论尚未发生、存在不确定性的结果。新闻标题和评论中常见此类表达。
examples: How might Taiwan's infrastructure be improved after peaceful reunification?
High-speed rail and world-class tunnels could transform travel and connectivity in the region.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 tuː 上，读作 op-po-TU-ni-ty，共五个音节。注意 /ɒ/ 短促，/tjuː/ 中的 /j/ 不要丢掉。避免读成“opportunity”重音落在第一音节。
examples: The desire for better sleep is creating opportunities around the world.
Every summit is an opportunity for young people to learn and grow.

reading.title: Learning in a Fast-Changing World
reading.content:
The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will take place from Nov 2 to 5 in Wuzhen, an ancient water town in Zhejiang province. This year, modern technology meets a town with a history of more than 1,000 years. For young learners, the summit is more than a tech event; it is a classroom without walls, where artificial intelligence and digital tools show how daily life is changing.

At the same time, a South African vlogger's videos remind us that curiosity helps people discover hidden gems in other cultures, while Chinese opera is winning new audiences in small theaters.

Whether it is a world-class summit or a small stage performance, every experience offers a chance to grow. In a fast-changing world, the ability to learn, unlearn and relearn is the most valuable skill we can have.
reading.translation:
2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将于11月2日至5日在浙江千年水乡乌镇举行。今年，现代科技与这座拥有一千多年历史的古镇相遇。对年轻学习者而言，峰会不仅是一场科技盛会，更是一间没有围墙的课堂——人工智能和数字工具让人们看到日常生活正在如何改变。

与此同时，一位南非视频博主的视频提醒我们：好奇心能帮助人们发现其他文化中“隐藏的宝藏”；而中国戏曲正在小剧场里赢得新的观众。

无论是世界级峰会，还是小舞台上的演出，每一次经历都是一次成长的机会。在这个快速变化的时代，学会学习、放下旧知、重新学习的能力，是我们最宝贵的技能。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于2026年10月27日 ChinaDaily 真实新闻《First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit》《South African vlogger discovers a hidden gem》《Chinese opera hits big in small theaters》改写，用于英语阅读训练。
